friendly_name: The Last Great Auks Are Killed
description: Fishermen strangled the last known pair of the North Atlantic's flightless penguin-like seabird on a rocky Icelandic islet.
scene: Two upright, penguin-like seabirds with heavy hooked bills stand on a wave-battered rock skerry as a rowing boat of fishermen pulls alongside under a stormy northern sky; non-graphic.
